What we fit

Fiat van wraps and signwriting.

Fiat vehicle graphics for businesses across Norwich and Norfolk, designed in-house and fitted at our workshop on Vulcan Road North.

Fiat signwriting

Cut vinyl lettering for your name, services and contact details, placed around the doors, handles and panel lines of your Fiat. From £149 for a small van.

Fiat van wraps

Partial wraps over selected panels or a full wrap for maximum impact, printed in-house on quality cast film.

Fiat fleet graphics

One consistent livery adapted to every Fiat model you run, with fleet numbers and files kept on record.

Before & after your graphics

Prep and protect your Fiat van.

Our sister business Auto Opulence offers valeting, polishing and ceramic coating in Norwich. Add it to your booking and your Fiat van arrives ready for graphics and leaves protected.

Before fitting

Decontamination wash

A deep clean, including a clay bar treatment, removes the road film and wax that stop vinyl bonding properly to your Fiat van.

Machine polish

Tired, dull paint can be machine polished before signwriting or a partial wrap, so the paint left on show looks as good as the new graphics.

After fitting

Ceramic coating

Protect the painted panels around your graphics with a long-lasting ceramic coating that makes washing quicker and keeps the gloss.

Regular hand wash

Gentle hand washing that is safe for vinyl, so your graphics and paint stay clean without brushes or harsh chemicals.

Add vehicle care to my quote ↗See Auto Opulence services ↗Washing from £30 · Valeting from £40 · Polishing from £295, prices from Auto Opulence.

Vehicle damaged?

We can organise panel repairs.

Graphics look their best on straight, sound panels, and vinyl cannot hide dents or rust. If your Fiat van needs some bodywork first, we can organise panel repairs as part of the service, so it comes back repaired and branded in one go.

  • Dents, scrapes and scuffed panels
  • Rust spots and chipped paint
  • Damaged bumpers and trims
Ask for details and a quote ↗Send photos of the damage with your enquiry and we will include the repair in your quote.

Before you book

Fiat van graphics Norwich: your questions.

Do you fit graphics to all Fiat vans?

Yes. We fit signwriting, partial wraps and full wraps to Fiat vans, pickups and commercial vehicles, laid out on your exact model.

How much are Fiat van graphics in Norwich?

Signwriting starts from £149 for a small van, £210 for a medium van and £285 for a large van, fitted. Wraps are quoted per vehicle.

Can you match my Fiat to the rest of my fleet?

Yes. We adapt one master layout to each make and model, so a mixed fleet still looks like one business.

Get a free quote

What are you driving?

Tell us the make and model, how many vehicles you have and the look you’re after. If you have photos or artwork, have them handy.
